root_cause: The previous mobile layout placed logo, menu and action group in separate RTL-sensitive grid columns, allowing controls to collide with the logo.
fix: Moved the mobile menu button into the same header-actions cluster as Search and Cart.
Compact header now uses a two-zone flex layout: protected logo zone + isolated controls zone.
RTL places the logo on the right and controls on the left; LTR mirrors naturally.
Hero, product UI, backend behavior and branding assets are untouched.
security: Off-canvas still handled by Bootstrap; no new inline JavaScript.
CSRF, CSP, MFA, rate limiting and audit controls unchanged.
